title: CROSSFILTER ONEWAY turns a both-direction relationship into a single-direction one for the calculation
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Model", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Product ), Customer[Country] = "Australia" ), "OneWay", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Product ), Customer[Country] = "Australia", CROSSFILTER ( Sales[SKU], Product[SKU], ONEWAY ) ) )

source.quote: CROSSFILTER will override any existing cross-filtering setting
source.supports: the model's setting is overridden by CROSSFILTER

source.quote: the cross-filter direction, which can be BOTH, ONEWAY, NONE
source.supports: ONEWAY is one of the three directions

derivation: Model setting (both): Australia -> Sales row 3 -> Product CL-01: 1 row. With ONEWAY the relationship only filters from Product to Sales, so the Customer filter stops at Sales and Product keeps its 3 rows.
